ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (centered on lobes) to low-intensity black pixels (margin and peduncle area).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous regions occupy the central interior of both lobes, transitioning into a dense black border approximately 10-15% of the fluke's vertical depth along the trailing edge; the central peduncle and notch area are dominated by low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior vertex angle of 85 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitudes of peak-to-valley variations range from 5 to 25 pixels, with greatest jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge displays a consistent concave curve from the outer tips moving toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark circular pixel clusters (possible barnacle scars) located in the lower-left white field and the lower-right white field near the boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark linear disruptions; a prominent diagonal mark on the mid-left lobe and vertical/diagonal rake-like marks on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and asymmetric trailing edge topography suggests significant historical tissue loss or traumatic wear, particularly evident at the extreme lateral tips.
